# Copilot instructions for this repository

See `AGENTS.md` at the project root for full onboarding instructions —
read it before doing anything else in this project.

Short version: this project builds with PlatformIO, not Arduino IDE.
Multiple AI agents (Claude, GitHub Copilot) share these same physical
boards, so get the user's explicit go-ahead in *this* conversation
before flashing, OTA-installing, or erasing any board, and check
`COPILOT_HANDOFF.md` first for an active hold from another agent.
